# Task 8 report: package status and resource refresh

## Implementation

- Added `mapConfiguredPackageStatus()` in `src/settings-dashboard.ts` to map Pi SDK `DefaultPackageManager.listConfiguredPackages()` entries to the credential-free dashboard protocol shape (`source`, `scope`, `installed`).
- `SettingsViewProvider.sendData()` now uses one canonical-agent-dir `SettingsManager` and `DefaultPackageManager`, calls `listConfiguredPackages()` without network installation, and reports installed/missing package counts and rows.
- Added focused dashboard tests covering one installed and one missing package, aggregate counts, and preservation of entry data.
- Moved resource-path/toggle reads into `startTuiBackend`'s runtime factory. Every newly created session now rereads canonical `settings.json` and rebuilds enabled bundled resource paths, so dashboard toggle changes apply to new sessions instead of stale activation-time snapshots.

## Scope decisions

The approved Task 8 brief explicitly makes dashboard refresh status-only: it says not to invoke network installation merely to display status. Accordingly, no new install command was added. Pi's SDK resource loading remains responsible for installing configured packages during new-session resource resolution; startup errors continue through the existing TUI backend error path.

## Validation

- `npx vitest run src/__tests__/settings-protocol.test.ts src/__tests__/pi-runtime-config.test.ts` — passed, 2 files / 10 tests.
- `npm run lint` — passed (`tsc -p ./tsconfig.json --noEmit`).
- `npm test -- --run` — passed, 14 files / 109 tests.
- `npm run build` — passed (webview and extension production builds).
- `git diff --check` — passed for owned staged changes.

## Commit

- `d27c851 feat: report canonical Pi package status`

Only the Task 8 hunks in `src/settings-dashboard.ts`, `src/settings-view.ts`, `src/__tests__/settings-protocol.test.ts`, and `src/extension.ts` were staged and committed. Existing unrelated/same-file unstaged changes in `src/extension.ts`, `src/__tests__/pi-runtime-config.test.ts`, and `webview-ui/src/settings/App.tsx` were preserved.

## Residual risks

- Actual VS Code Extension Development Host behavior for native file opening remains a manual check from Task 6.
- Package installation/reconciliation is exercised by Pi's loader on new-session startup rather than a dashboard-triggered network action, per the approved Task 8 brief.
- No VS Code host integration test exercises `SettingsViewProvider` SDK construction directly; pure dashboard mapping and full suite coverage pass.

## Review follow-up

- Added `collectConfiguredPackageStatus()` to exercise the same `SettingsManager.create(cwd, agentDir)` and `DefaultPackageManager.listConfiguredPackages()` boundary used by `SettingsViewProvider`; the fake-agent test writes one configured installed npm package and one missing package, asserts the expected counts/source, and verifies no missing package directory is created (no install/network side effect).
- Added `buildCurrentPiRuntimeResourcePaths()` as the runtime-factory call-time settings seam and a behavior test that changes the settings object between two calls; the second resource set excludes disabled `custom-footer` while retaining `filechanges`.
- Reverted the unrelated `isBundledResourceId` formatting-only hunk in `src/settings-view.ts`.
- Focused tests: `npx vitest run src/__tests__/settings-protocol.test.ts src/__tests__/pi-runtime-config.test.ts src/__tests__/pi-store.test.ts` — passed, 3 files / 33 tests.
- Lint: `npm run lint` — passed.
- No owned files are staged; unrelated same-file changes remain preserved in the worktree.
